notes.title: Alna Mog'rak - Design evolution
notes.notes:
[h2]Before you meet her in-game, let's take a look back at how her design changed overtime![/h2][p][/p][h3]Alna Mog'rak, a tough-as-nails orc warrior with a massive shield, is the heart of Mana Quest’s adventuring party. She started as one of the game’s earliest designs but went through major changes to become the fierce tank she is today. [/h3][h3]Fun fact: she wasn’t even an orc at first! But that's a story for another time. [/h3][p][/p][h3]As the game evolved, Alna’s initial look didn’t quite fit. After community polls and feedback, we changed her hairstyle a bit:[/h3][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/c02764e848116166615975ce0a2f685c2a1e2259.jpg"][/img]
Multiple rounds of voting in community polls were done in order to help decide on some of Alna's design details, but in the end the "civilized" look just didn't fit her. A new sketch was presented that would take her design in a different direction.[/h3][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/b107883db0f9a351f199c41a4eda24669ce0cfab.png"][/img]
She was given a bold tribal makeover to grant her a more feral, fierce vibe suitable for an orc. Not long after, her final final look as it now appears in-game was distilled from all the concepts:[/h3][h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/75b9e7804d99b80722ae5fd15104f450be79a412.png"][/img]
These changes locked in Alna’s design early, letting me focus on her content without worrying about future tweaks. What do you think of her transformation?

notes.title: Welcome to Hoppe: Mana Quest's Hub
notes.notes:
[h1]An introduction to Hoppe[/h1]
[h3]
Today we're taking a look at the city you'll come to call home in Mana Quest — Hoppe! Between world-hopping sorties, you'll spend your time in this vibrant hub of commerce. Across its districts and outskirts, Hoppe is home to a bustling marketplace, harbor and airship dock, arena, brothel, royal palace, and the ever-important Seeker's Guild.

Relaxing and enjoying the city's amenities isn't all you'll find yourself doing when you're not out questing. There's plenty of ways to get busy around town plying your trade as a merchant, working your own farm, and bonding with a whole cast of lovely ladies. 😉

Here's a peek behind the scenes at how Hoppe has developed over time as details were added and fleshed out:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/d37cf915982be4126d517e45a84c03ac89e87e04.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/64dd89d6107bb3f719bed745a30a4087e315d366.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/265ea16c0b3cdf242d8854d8331b19eb93085fae.png[/img]

Things have come together, the city is looking good, but another detailing pass is done...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/02400985832eaf2419d4d9cf8b45a7e5ac33b472.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/33934db62f7c07d135819b53b8b025782332bb3f.png[/img]

...and we arrive at our final version (with nighttime details, to boot!):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44699498/3f449d9a9450cc3bc2bfd5369275e9c604d21b8b.jpg[/img]

For an isekai protag, I'd say this is a pretty good roll for where to wind up! 😏
